study_meta.region_raw: Mainland China (outside Hubei province); 27 provincial and 264 urban health commissions
study_meta.period_raw: 9 January to 13 February 2020 (36-day period); prepeak: 9-22 Jan 2020; peak week: 23-29 Jan 2020; postpeak: 30 Jan-13 Feb 2020
study_meta.population_raw: Confirmed COVID-19 cases from transmission pairs; Hubei province excluded due to less reliable transmission chain information
study_meta.sample_size_raw: 677 transmission pairs with symptom-onset dates available (out of 1407 in database); prepeak: 162 pairs; peak week: 339 pairs; postpeak: 176 pairs
study_meta.method_raw: Line-list database of transmission pairs; serial interval computed as days between symptom-onset date of infector and infectee; normal distribution fitted using MCMC; running time windows of 10, 14, or 18 days
